what: One new input column of the learned mean correction's first layer (enc0) with its 128 weights after ONE line-search step along the mean of 36 exact network gradients.

files.u_128: the 128 weights of the new column (float32)
files.enc0_w_127: the parent enc0_w (128 x 126) with the new column inserted at index 30 (after the 30 feature columns, before the 96 message columns)
files.enc0_w_features_31: the first 31 columns of that array (30 features + the new one)
files.torch_pred: predictions of all 16 layers (16 x 1024, float32) of the torch card on ranks 651 and 378 with the column off and on: the parity target is their difference

column_definition: layers 1..14 only; layers 0 and 15 and the final-layer feature function: 0
rows = the response rows of this layer's bank read
B_ii = diagonal of the law's matrix on the columns pushed into the layer: sum_r (w_r pp_ir^2 + x_r pp_ir pp_i,partner(r))

fit = least squares of B_ii over those rows on (tr C v_i, 1, mu_i^2, 2 mu_i (C mu)_i); C = pre-activation covariance, v its diagonal floored at 1e-12, mu = pre-activation mean, C mu over all units; float64
x_i = (B_ii - fit_i) / (tr C v_i) on the rows
z_i = clip((x_i - mean) / sd, -8, 8), mean and sd over the rows, sd with n - 1; 0 if sd is 0 or not finite
float32; enc0 pre-activation = [30 features, 96 messages] enc0_w' + enc0_b + z_i u'  (as a 31st feature column: centre 0, scale 1 for every layer, layer-15 mask 1)
card: S39 card (candidate 3 + star by row sums), pair law with the constant regressor and three forms, k31l on cohorts of ages 1-2 at strength 1, second dials (O/trainer/candidates/law_dials_d7_ages12: candidate.py sha c2b7f6839646 + its physics_dials.json)
judged: first 25 judging ranks, torch, forward only, final-layer MSE: against the same card without the column -1.787% (se 0.286, better on 23 of 25; all layers -2.028%); against the same card with the FIRST dials (the S41 arithmetic in torch) -2.612% (se 0.344, 23 of 25; all layers -2.868%)
line_search: 16 line-search ranks: step 0.1 -1.154% (16 of 16), 0.25 -1.740%, 0.5 +0.031%; parabola minimum 0.2484 (the weights' length), -1.75%
gradient: mean over 36 training networks at zero weights: 105 of 128 weights beyond 3 standard errors, mean t squared 55, split-half cosine 0.98 (all-units version of the column; the response-rows version gives the same first step)
